Game Overview

In Just Golf, the core idea is straightforward: guide your ball through 210 minimalist golf puzzles with precision and technique. Harness an aim assist to perfect your shots while navigating obstacles, and strive for mastery by collecting stars at every level. The game's simplicity and challenge blend seamlessly for an engaging experience.
